task_completion.description: OpenBCI GUI application is launched and visible.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The OpenBCI GUI window is open on the desktop, showing the initial setup or main interface.

task_completion.description: A synthetic data session is initiated.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The control panel shows 'SYNTHETIC (algorithmic)' selected as the data source and the 'Start System' or 'Stream Data' button has been pressed, showing active waveforms.

task_completion.description: The 'FFT Plot' widget is removed from the dashboard layout.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The area previously occupied by the 'FFT Plot' (typically a frequency graph) is either empty or replaced by a dropdown menu/different widget.

task_completion.description: The 'Head Plot' widget is added to the dashboard layout.
task_completion.visual_evidence: A 'Head Plot' widget (showing a top-down view of a human head with electrode locations) is visible in the GUI layout.

task_completion.description: A screenshot of the customized layout is saved to the specific file path.
task_completion.visual_evidence: A file manager window or terminal output confirms the creation of 'head_plot_layout.png' in the '~/Documents/OpenBCI_GUI/Screenshots/' directory.

integrity.description: The agent interacted with the GUI elements rather than just using terminal commands to move files.
integrity.visual_evidence: Screenshots show the mouse cursor hovering over widget selection dropdowns or the 'Head Plot' option being selected within the OpenBCI interface.

integrity.description: The agent is using the actual OpenBCI GUI software, not a static image or mockup.
integrity.visual_evidence: The EEG data streams (waveforms) show dynamic movement or changes across different screenshots in the trajectory.

integrity.description: The screenshot was generated by the GUI's internal screenshot function or a system screenshot of the live app, not by renaming an existing file.
integrity.visual_evidence: The screenshot 'head_plot_layout.png' matches the state of the GUI visible in the final steps of the agent's trajectory.

privileged_info_for_vlm: The OpenBCI GUI uses 'FFT Plot' for frequency data and 'Head Plot' for spatial electrode mapping. The synthetic session must be started by selecting 'SYNTHETIC (algorithmic)' in the session settings. The required screenshot path is /home/ga/Documents/OpenBCI_GUI/Screenshots/head_plot_layout.png. The Head Plot widget is identifiable by a circular head diagram with colored dots representing channels.
